findings.quoted_text: Except as otherwise detailed in this Agreement, the Parties acknowledge and agree that the Subject Program including without limitation the Deliverables and Documentation (collectively, the Works) are "work made for hire" in accordance with the U.S. Copyright Act, 17 U.S.C. § 101 et seq. Accordingly, Client will be the copyright author and owner of all of the Works. To the extent permissible, Developer hereby assigns and transfers to Client all copyright and other intellectual property ownership in the Works.

findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership of your work transfers immediately upon creation or via work-made-for-hire terms rather than waiting until you are paid, which is risky if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment of all fees due under this Agreement, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in the final Deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Before we sign the agreement, I wanted to raise one quick point: - Regarding the relevant clause, the text currently transfers intellectual property ownership immediately instead of waiting for payment. I propose modifying this so that the Contractor assigns rights to the Client upon receipt of full payment of all fees due under this agreement. Please let me know your thoughts. Best regards,
